body:
## Problem
In `packages/quartermaster/lib/registry.mjs`, `validateRegistry` returns `Object.freeze(raw)` — a shallow freeze that leaves `registry.channels`, each channel seat, `registry.reviewerGroups`, each group and member object, and `registry.modelProviders` mutable after validation and after the §8a `registryDigest` is computed (#737).

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `validateRegistry` recursively freezes the validated registry document (`channels`, each channel seat, `reviewerGroups`, each group, `members` array, each member object, and `modelProviders` / adapter maps) before returning it, so mutating any nested property (such as `registry.channels.frontier.model`, `registry.reviewerGroups.crossModel.members[0].model`, or `registry.modelProviders.opencode`) throws `TypeError` in strict mode. Verify: `node --test packages/quartermaster/test/registry-validation.test.mjs`.
2. Existing quartermaster routing and provider normalization tests pass unchanged. Verify: `node --test packages/quartermaster/test/route-job.test.mjs packages/quartermaster/test/provider-normalization.test.mjs`.
title: fix(quartermaster): deep-freeze validated registry document so seats and reviewerGroups cannot be mutated (#737)
